scope: N06 shared transport with core-local views/endpoints and host concurrency; no H417 gate/cache backend
shared: Fabric, epoch, hint bits, worker admission, active turn permits, quiescent declarations; protected by one outer try Gate per transport call
local: View references, one normal-caller Endpoint, executor registration/callback, in-progress lease, cursor, results and cleanup state
callback_budget: one message or one block take/release or at most eight byte reads
recovery: close all new operations; wait for active normal turns including retryable close; attest explicit worker offline and DMA quiet declarations; restart epoch
note: reserve Rejected still combines capacity/generation refusal; typed result experiment is not public API adoption
not_verified: MCU operation time or peak stack
